Definition glu_rel_ctx Γ : Prop := exists Sb, EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ Sb.
#[global] Arguments glu_rel_ctx Γ/.

A module expression glued in a context: at every glued environment of the context, its value is glued as it.
Definition glu_modexp_at (Γ : ctx) (H : modexp) : Prop :=
  forall Sb, EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ Sb ->
    forall Δ σ ρ, Δ ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ Sb ->
      exists h, ⟦ H ⟧ᵐ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ h /\ glu_dmod Δ σ Γ H h.

A term glued at its type: the gluing of the context, a universe level for the type, and the gluing of the term under every substitution glued in the context.
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record glu_rel_exp Γ M A : Prop := mk_glu_rel_exp
  { glu_rel_exp_sb : glu_sub_pred
  ; glu_rel_exp_ctx : EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ glu_rel_exp_sb
  ; glu_rel_exp_lvl : nat
  ; glu_rel_exp_body : forall Δ σ ρ,
      Δ ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ glu_rel_exp_sb ->
      glu_rel_exp_with_sub glu_rel_exp_lvl Δ M A σ ρ }.

Notation "⊩ Γ" := (glu_rel_ctx Γ) (at level 70).
Notation "Γ ⊩ M : A" := (glu_rel_exp Γ M A) (at level 70, M at level 69, A at level 69).

The Fundamental Theorem's Judgments

The value of a substituted term is not the value of the term at the substitution's value: a kept proof ⋆ᵈ⟨N[τ], ρ⟩ is not ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρτ⟩. So no lemma moves a glued term along a substitution, and the fundamental theorem instead glues every instance of a typed term at substitutions of a fixed form (glu_rel_exp_under_sub), each instance at its own value. The definitions are layered: each mentions only the ones before it. The components of those substitutions are glued at every renaming (glu_rel_exp_under_renaming), which closes them under the weakenings binders introduce; a renaming has no components of its own, so the layering ends there.
A term glued at every renaming of its context into a glued one.
Definition glu_rel_exp_under_renaming (Γ : ctx) (M A : exp) : Prop :=
  forall Γ' φ, Γ' ⊢ʷ φ : Γ -> ⊩ Γ' -> Γ' ⊩ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ.

An extension Ψ of Γ glued at every renaming of Γ into a glued context: the extended context, the extension weakened, is glued. Only the entries of Ψ are asked for, not the base's own types: an instance only gives ⊩ Γ' of its domain, so a judgment asking for the types of the base would not hold at the instances. The definition is closed under renaming of Γ, and it holds at each instance of Γ through the instance lifted through Ψ (glu_rel_ext_under_sub).
Definition glu_rel_ext_under_renaming (Γ Ψ : ctx) : Prop :=
  forall Γ' φ, Γ' ⊢ʷ φ : Γ -> ⊩ Γ' -> ⊩ (tele_wk Ψ φ ++ Γ')%list.

A unit glued at the context Γ it is closed over: a body's expansion (gm_expand, as evaluation reads the body), its entries over the unit's parameters, is an extension of Γ glued at every renaming of Γ, and so is each module entry's unit, recursively, at the context of the expanded entries before it; an alias's parameters are an extension glued so, and its target is glued as a module expression over them. The recursion is on the unit: a body's module entries, those of the fragments its opens store included, are its subterms.
Fixpoint glu_unit_at (Γ : ctx) (U : gunit) {struct U} : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δu (md_body _ Φ) =>
      glu_rel_ext_under_renaming Γ (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ) ++ Δu) /\ glu_gmod_units (Δu ++ Γ) Φ
  | gu_mk Δu (md_alias E) => glu_rel_ext_under_renaming Γ Δu /\ glu_modexp_at (Δu ++ Γ) E
  end
The module entries of a body over Γ, each glued at the context of the expanded entries before it, and those of the fragment each open stores, which the expansion grafts after the entries before the open.
with glu_gmod_units (Γ : ctx) (Φ : gmod) {struct Φ} : Prop :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_mod _ U) =>
      glu_gmod_units Γ Φ' /\ glu_unit_at (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ) U
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_def_mod _ _ _ U) =>
      glu_gmod_units Γ Φ' /\ glu_unit_at (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ) U
  | gm_ext Φ' _ _ => glu_gmod_units Γ Φ'
  | gm_open Φ' _ _ Φg => glu_gmod_units Γ Φ' /\ glu_gmod_units (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ) Φg
  end.

A unit glued at every renaming of its context into a glued one.
Definition glu_unit_under_renaming (Γ : ctx) (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  forall Γ' φ, Γ' ⊢ʷ φ : Γ -> ⊩ Γ' -> glu_unit_at Γ' (gunit_wk U φ).

A substitution the fundamental theorem instantiates terms at: typed, out of a glued context, its term components glued at their types at every renaming, and the units of its module components glued at every renaming. Module values are not glued: a member of a module is reached through its unit's body context. The instances are closed under renaming, so a term glued at all of them is glued at every renaming of each.
Record glu_rel_sub_inst (Γ : ctx) (τ : sub) (Δ : ctx) : Prop := mk_glu_rel_sub_inst
  {
The substitution is typed
    glu_rel_sub_inst_typed : Γ ⊢ˢ τ : Δ
    
Its domain is glued
  ; glu_rel_sub_inst_ctx : ⊩ Γ
    
Each term component is glued at its type at every renaming
  ; glu_rel_sub_inst_comps : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> glu_rel_exp_under_renaming Γ #x[τ] A[τ]
    
The unit of each module component is glued at every renaming
  ; glu_rel_sub_inst_mods : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> glu_unit_under_renaming Γ U[τ]ᵘ }.

A glued context whose variables' types are glued at every renaming, each as a term of a sort of types, and whose module slots' units are glued at every renaming: the fundamental theorem's judgment of contexts. A variable is then glued at its type at every renaming, so every renaming into a glued context is an instance, the identity among them.
Record glu_rel_ctx_types (Γ : ctx) : Prop := mk_glu_rel_ctx_types
  {
The context is glued
    glu_rel_ctx_types_ctx : ⊩ Γ
    
The type of each variable is glued, at every renaming, as a term of a sort of types
  ; glu_rel_ctx_types_types : forall x A, Γ ∋ #x : A ->
      exists S, type_sort S /\ glu_rel_exp_under_renaming Γ A S
    
The unit of each module slot is glued at every renaming
  ; glu_rel_ctx_types_slots : forall x U, Γ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> glu_unit_under_renaming Γ U }.

A unit glued at each of its instances: the fundamental theorem's judgment of units.
Definition glu_rel_unit_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  forall Γ τ, glu_rel_sub_inst Γ τ Δ -> glu_unit_at Γ U[τ]ᵘ.

A term all of whose instances at those substitutions are glued, each at its own value, in a context as the fundamental theorem glues it: the fundamental theorem's judgment of terms. The identity is an instance, so the term is glued.
Record glu_rel_exp_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (M A : exp) : Prop := mk_glu_rel_exp_under_sub
  {
The context is glued with its variables' types
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub_ctx : glu_rel_ctx_types Δ
    
Each instance is glued
  ; glu_rel_exp_under_sub_inst : forall Γ τ, glu_rel_sub_inst Γ τ Δ -> Γ ⊩ M[τ] : A[τ] }.

A module expression all of whose instances are glued, in a context as the fundamental theorem glues it: the fundamental theorem's judgment of module expressions.
Record glu_rel_modexp_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (H : modexp) : Prop := mk_glu_rel_modexp_under_sub
  {
The context is glued with its variables' types
    glu_rel_modexp_under_sub_ctx : glu_rel_ctx_types Δ
    
Each instance is glued
  ; glu_rel_modexp_under_sub_inst : forall Γ τ, glu_rel_sub_inst Γ τ Δ -> glu_modexp_at Γ H[τ]ᵐ }.

A definition entry A ≔ M glued at the instances of the context Δ it extends, its type at the sort S.
Record glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (A M : exp) (S : typ) : Prop := mk_glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub
  {
The sort is a sort of types
    glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub_type_sort : type_sort S
    
The type is glued at the instances at its sort
  ; glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub_type : glu_rel_exp_under_sub Δ A S
    
The body is glued at the instances at the type
  ; glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub_body : glu_rel_exp_under_sub Δ M A }.

A definition with a module part A ≔ M ‖ U glued at the instances of the context Δ it extends, its type in the universe of the level i and its module part an alias of E under no parameters (wf_ctx_extend_dm).
Record glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (A M : exp) (U : gunit) (i : nat) (E : modexp) : Prop :=
  mk_glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub
  {
The module part is an alias of the target under no parameters
    glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub_alias : U = gu_mk nil (md_alias E)
    
The type is glued at the instances in its universe
  ; glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub_type : glu_rel_exp_under_sub Δ A Typeω@i
    
The body is glued at the instances at the type
  ; glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub_body : glu_rel_exp_under_sub Δ M A
    
The module part is well formed
  ; glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub_unit_wf : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U
    
The module part is glued at the instances
  ; glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub_unit : glu_rel_unit_under_sub Δ U }.

The parts of an entry glued at the instances of the context Δ it extends: an assumption's type at a sort of its kind, a definition's type and body, a module slot's unit, well formed, and a definition with a module part's type, body and alias.
Definition glu_rel_entry_under_sub (Δ : ctx) (e : centry) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | ce_ass κ A => exists S, sort_kind S κ /\ glu_rel_exp_under_sub Δ A S
  | ce_def A M => exists S, glu_rel_def_entry_under_sub Δ A M S
  | ce_mod U => gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U /\ glu_rel_unit_under_sub Δ U
  | ce_dm A M U => exists (i : nat) E, glu_rel_module_def_entry_under_sub Δ A M U i E
  end.

An extension Ψ of a context Γ glued at the instances: the context is glued with its variables' types, and each entry's parts are glued at the instances of the context before it. An instance of Γ then lifts through Ψ and through every suffix of it (Extensions.v), and a term glued at the instances of Ψ ++ Γ is glued at each lifted instance, as a binder's body is: the fundamental theorem's judgment of extensions. Each entry is glued at its own prefix's instances, not only at the whole extension's: the unit of a module entry is read at the context before it, as a nested module's members are.
Fixpoint glu_rel_ext_under_sub (Γ Ψ : ctx) : Prop :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => glu_rel_ctx_types Γ
  | e :: Ψ' => glu_rel_ext_under_sub Γ Ψ' /\ glu_rel_entry_under_sub (Ψ' ++ Γ)%list e
  end.

Deep Units

A unit substituted at a substitution that is not an instance at hand, the β instance (Id,,N) of wf_me_beta_body or the fill of a selected submodule (wf_me_delta_sel), is glued from its body glued at the instances, not at the renamings only: a deep unit. The judgments carry the deep module parts of their contexts (glu_ctx_deep), which a module slot's description reads.
The parts of an alias glued deeply (glu_unit_deep): its parameters an extension glued at the instances, its target glued at the instances, and the target's own parts deep (target_parts, the recursive part glu_modexp_parts_deep, passed as a proposition).
Record glu_alias_deep_parts (Γ Δu : ctx) (E : modexp) (target_parts : Prop) : Prop := mk_glu_alias_deep_parts
  {
The parameters are an extension glued at the instances
    glu_alias_deep_parts_params : glu_rel_ext_under_sub Γ Δu
    
The target is glued at the instances
  ; glu_alias_deep_parts_target : glu_rel_modexp_under_sub (Δu ++ Γ)%list E
    
The target's literals and application arguments are deep
  ; glu_alias_deep_parts_target_parts : target_parts }.

The argument N of an application of E in a module expression, glued deeply: E is typed, and N is glued at the instances at the outermost parameter of what E denotes, as wf_me_app types it.
Record glu_app_arg_deep (Γ : ctx) (E : modexp) (N : exp) : Prop := mk_glu_app_arg_deep
  {
The module expression applied is typed
    glu_app_arg_deep_fun_wf : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E
    
The argument is glued at the instances at its parameter
  ; glu_app_arg_deep_arg : forall R T B T1, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ E R -> mdesc_mod_tele R = Some T ->
      tele_view T = Some (B, T1) -> glu_rel_exp_under_sub Γ N B }.

A unit glued at the instances of the context Γ it is closed over: as glu_unit_at, with every "at every renaming" an "at the instances". A body's expansion, its entries over the unit's parameters, is an extension glued at the instances (glu_rel_ext_under_sub), and each of its module entries' units is deep, recursively, at the context of the expanded entries before it. An alias's parts are glued at the instances (glu_alias_deep_parts).
Fixpoint glu_unit_deep (Γ : ctx) (U : gunit) {struct U} : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δu (md_body _ Φ) =>
      glu_rel_ext_under_sub Γ (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ) ++ Δu)%list /\ glu_gmod_units_deep (Δu ++ Γ)%list Φ
  | gu_mk Δu (md_alias E) => glu_alias_deep_parts Γ Δu E (glu_modexp_parts_deep (Δu ++ Γ)%list E)
  end
The module entries of a body, each deep at the context of the expanded entries before it, as glu_gmod_units
with glu_gmod_units_deep (Γ : ctx) (Φ : gmod) {struct Φ} : Prop :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_mod _ U) => glu_gmod_units_deep Γ Φ' /\ glu_unit_deep (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ)%list U
  | gm_ext Φ' _ (ge_def_mod _ _ _ U) => glu_gmod_units_deep Γ Φ' /\ glu_unit_deep (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ)%list U
  | gm_ext Φ' _ _ => glu_gmod_units_deep Γ Φ'
  | gm_open Φ' _ _ Φg => glu_gmod_units_deep Γ Φ' /\ glu_gmod_units_deep (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ') ++ Γ)%list Φg
  end
The parts a module expression is built from, deep: its literals, and the arguments of its applications (glu_app_arg_deep)
with glu_modexp_parts_deep (Γ : ctx) (E : modexp) {struct E} : Prop :=
  match E with
  | me_lit U => glu_unit_deep Γ U
  | me_mem E' _ => glu_modexp_parts_deep Γ E'
  | me_app E' N => glu_modexp_parts_deep Γ E' /\ glu_app_arg_deep Γ E' N
  | me_unit _ | me_var _ => True
  end.

The arguments Ns of a closed module, filling in order the outermost parameters of its telescope T, glued at the instances, each at its parameter instantiated by those before it, as args_ok types them.
Definition glu_args_deep (Γ T : ctx) (Ns : list exp) : Prop :=
  forall Trest Tfilled, T = (Trest ++ Tfilled)%list -> List.length Tfilled = List.length Ns ->
  forall k N A, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts Tfilled Id Ns) k = Some A ->
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub Γ N A.

A description deep in Γ, in what its module part names as a unit (mdesc_unit): an open module's literal is a deep unit; a closed module's outer parameters are an extension glued at the instances, and its arguments are glued at the instances over them. It is what the right-hand side of wf_me_delta_sel needs to be glued at each instance: the literal a selection stands for, or the stored module applied to the description's own arguments, whose values are not those of the module expression selected from.
Definition glu_desc_deep (Γ : ctx) (R : mdesc) : Prop :=
  match mdesc_mod R with
  | Some (mdesc_open Δ Φ _) => glu_unit_deep Γ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_open Φ))
  | Some (mdesc_closed Θ' _ T _ Ns) => glu_rel_ext_under_sub Γ Θ' /\ glu_args_deep (Θ' ++ Γ)%list T Ns
  | _ => True
  end.

The module parts of a context deep, each at the context before it: the unit of a module slot, and of a definition with a module part (centry_unit). It is what a slot root's description needs to be deep: the slot reads its unit.
Definition glu_ctx_deep (Γ : ctx) : Prop :=
  forall Γ1 e Γ0 U, Γ = (Γ1 ++ e :: Γ0)%list -> centry_unit e = Some U -> glu_unit_deep Γ0 U.

The empty context has none.
Lemma glu_ctx_deep_nil : glu_ctx_deep nil.
Proof. intros [| ? ?] * E; discriminate. Qed.

The module parts of a context's suffix are among the context's.
Lemma glu_ctx_deep_suffix : forall Ψ Γ, glu_ctx_deep (Ψ ++ Γ)%list -> glu_ctx_deep Γ.
Proof. intros * H Γ1 e Γ0 U E Hu; apply (H (Ψ ++ Γ1)%list e Γ0 U); [ rewrite E, List.app_assoc; reflexivity | exact Hu ]. Qed.

So are those of its tail.
Lemma glu_ctx_deep_tail : forall e Γ, glu_ctx_deep (e :: Γ)%list -> glu_ctx_deep Γ.
Proof. intros * H; exact (glu_ctx_deep_suffix (e :: nil) Γ H). Qed.

An entry with no module part adds none.
Lemma glu_ctx_deep_cons_term : forall e Γ, centry_unit e = None -> glu_ctx_deep Γ -> glu_ctx_deep (e :: Γ)%list.
Proof.
  intros * He H [| e' Γ1] e0 Γ0 U E Hu; cbn in E; injection E as -> E.
  - rewrite He in Hu; discriminate.
  - exact (H Γ1 e0 Γ0 U E Hu).
Qed.

A weakening glued from Γ to Δ, as Γ ⊨ʷ φ : Δ in the PER model: precomposed with it, a substitution glued into Γ at ρ is glued into Δ at ⟪φ⟫ ρ. Unlike a substitution, a weakening acts on environments without evaluation, so the judgment can be stated; it weakens term judgments (glu_rel_exp_wk).
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record glu_rel_wk Γ φ Δ : Prop := mk_glu_rel_wk
  {
The glued substitutions into the source
    glu_rel_wk_sb : glu_sub_pred
  ; glu_rel_wk_ctx : EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ glu_rel_wk_sb
    
The glued substitutions into the target
  ; glu_rel_wk_sb' : glu_sub_pred
  ; glu_rel_wk_ctx' : EG Δ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ glu_rel_wk_sb'
    
The weakening is well formed
  ; glu_rel_wk_typed : Γ ⊢ʷ φ : Δ
    
The weakening is semantic: it takes related environments to related ones, the kinds of the entries agreeing
  ; glu_rel_wk_sem : Γ ⊨ʷ φ : Δ
    
A substitution glued into the source, precomposed with the weakening, is glued into the target at the weakened environment
  ; glu_rel_wk_glu : forall Δ' σ ρ, Δ' ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ glu_rel_wk_sb -> Δ' ⊢ˢ ι φ ⨟ σ ® ⟪φ⟫ ρ ∈ glu_rel_wk_sb' }.

Notation "Γ ⊩ʷ φ : Δ" := (glu_rel_wk Γ φ Δ) (at level 70, φ constr at level 0, Δ at level 69).

A substitution glued from Γ to Δ: precomposed with it, a substitution glued into Γ at ρ is glued into Δ at an environment the context PER of Δ relates to the value of τ at ρ. The value itself stores the entries at Δ's types (ctx_retag, centry_tag), the glued environment at any related ones. It is semantic, so the values of M[τ] at ρ and of M there are related, and term judgments move along it (glu_rel_exp_sub).
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record glu_rel_sub Γ τ Δ : Prop := mk_glu_rel_sub
  {
The glued substitutions into the source
    glu_rel_sub_sb : glu_sub_pred
  ; glu_rel_sub_ctx : EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ glu_rel_sub_sb
    
The glued substitutions into the target
  ; glu_rel_sub_sb' : glu_sub_pred
  ; glu_rel_sub_ctx' : EG Δ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ glu_rel_sub_sb'
    
The substitution is well formed
  ; glu_rel_sub_typed : Γ ⊢ˢ τ : Δ
    
It is semantic
  ; glu_rel_sub_sem : Γ ⊨ˢ τ ≈ τ : Δ
    
A substitution glued into the source, precomposed with it, is glued into the target at an environment related to its value
  ; glu_rel_sub_glu : forall Δ' σ ρ, Δ' ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ glu_rel_sub_sb ->
      exists ρτ, Δ' ⊢ˢ τ ⨟ σ ® ρτ ∈ glu_rel_sub_sb' /\
        forall RΔ ρτ0, EF Δ ≈ Δ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΔ -> ⟦ τ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ0 -> Dom ρτ0 ≈ ρτ ∈ RΔ }.

Notation "Γ ⊩ˢ τ : Δ" := (glu_rel_sub Γ τ Δ) (at level 70, τ at level 69, Δ at level 69).

End Fixed_GCtx.

#[export]
Hint Rewrite @glu_univ_elem_equation_1 : glu_univ_elem.

Notation "'glu_typ_pred_args'" := (Tcons ctx (Tcons typ Tnil)).
Notation "'glu_typ_pred'" := (predicate glu_typ_pred_args).
Notation "'glu_typ_pred_equivalence'" := (@predicate_equivalence glu_typ_pred_args) (only parsing).
Notation "Γ ⊢ A ® R" := ((R Γ A : (Prop : Type)) : (Prop : (Type : Type))) (at level 70, A at level 69, R constr).
Notation "'glu_exp_pred_args'" := (Tcons ctx (Tcons typ (Tcons exp (Tcons domain Tnil)))).
Notation "'glu_exp_pred'" := (predicate glu_exp_pred_args).
Notation "'glu_exp_pred_equivalence'" := (@predicate_equivalence glu_exp_pred_args) (only parsing).
Notation "Γ ⊢ M : A ® m ∈ R" := (R Γ A M m : (Prop : (Type : Type))) (at level 70, M at level 69, m at level 69, R constr).
Notation "'glu_sub_pred_args'" := (Tcons ctx (Tcons sub (Tcons env Tnil))).
Notation "'glu_sub_pred'" := (predicate glu_sub_pred_args).
Notation "'glu_sub_pred_equivalence'" := (@predicate_equivalence glu_sub_pred_args) (only parsing).
Notation "Γ ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ R" := ((R Γ σ ρ : Prop) : (Prop : (Type : Type))) (at level 70, σ at level 69, ρ at level 69, R constr).
Notation "'DG' a ∈ R ↘ P ↘ El" := (R P El a : ((Prop : Type) : (Type : Type))) (at level 70, a at level 69, R constr, P constr, El constr).
Notation "'EG' A ∈ R ↘ Sb " := (R Sb A : ((Prop : (Type : Type)) : (Type : Type))) (at level 70, A at level 69, R constr, Sb constr).

#[export]
Hint Constructors neut_glu_exp_pred pi_glu_typ_pred pi_glu_exp_pred : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors proof_glu_exp prop_univ_glu_exp level_sort_glu_exp : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors glu_univ_elem_core : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors glu_elem_bot : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors glu_elem_top : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors glu_typ_top : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors level_glu_exp suniv_glu_typ univ_glu_exp suniv_glu_exp glu_typ_at : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Constructors glu_params_top glu_nparams ind_glu_components ind_glu_exp : mctt.
The automation builds the record-shaped gluing predicates like the existentials they replace. The hint has no pattern: a pattern headed by one of these definitions is not found by the database, which unfolds it.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 =>
  match goal with
  | |- level_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- suniv_glu_typ_pred _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- univ_glu_exp_pred' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- suniv_glu_exp_pred' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- proof_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- prop_univ_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- level_sort_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- univ_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- suniv_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- glu_univ_typ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  | |- ind_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => econstructor
  end : mctt.
Notation "⊩ Γ" := (glu_rel_ctx Γ) (at level 70).
Notation "Γ ⊩ M : A" := (glu_rel_exp Γ M A) (at level 70, M at level 69, A at level 69).
Notation "Γ ⊩ʷ φ : Δ" := (glu_rel_wk Γ φ Δ) (at level 70, φ constr at level 0, Δ at level 69).
Notation "Γ ⊩ˢ τ : Δ" := (glu_rel_sub Γ τ Δ) (at level 70, τ at level 69, Δ at level 69).

induction H using glu_univ_elem_ind does not apply, for the reason per_univ_elem_induction explains. The tactics below perform the same induction.
Ltac glu_induction_hintro := let H := fresh "H" in intro H.

Ltac glu_univ_elem_induction_core HH ih :=
  lazymatch type of HH with
  | glu_univ_elem ?i ?P ?El ?a =>
      repeat match goal with
             | Hd : ?T |- _ =>
                 lazymatch Hd with HH => fail | i => fail | P => fail | El => fail | a => fail | _ => idtac end;
                 lazymatch T with
                 | context [i] => revert Hd | context [P] => revert Hd
                 | context [El] => revert Hd | context [a] => revert Hd
                 end
             end;
      revert HH; revert i P El a;
      refine (glu_univ_elem_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _);
      
In order: a large universe, a small one, Level@n, Prop, LevelSort, Π, a proposition, a neutral type, an inductive type, a record type; each case's binders, then its hypotheses.
      [ do 5 intro; do 3 glu_induction_hintro | do 5 intro; do 4 glu_induction_hintro
      | do 4 intro; do 2 glu_induction_hintro | do 3 intro; do 2 glu_induction_hintro
      | do 4 intro; do 3 glu_induction_hintro
      | do 14 intro; glu_induction_hintro; ih; do 7 glu_induction_hintro
      | do 4 intro; do 3 glu_induction_hintro | do 5 intro; do 4 glu_induction_hintro
      | do 17 intro; do 17 glu_induction_hintro | do 9 intro; do 7 glu_induction_hintro ]; cbv beta
  end.

As induction H using glu_univ_elem_ind: the hypothesis on the motive at the domain of a Π is IHH; those under a binder are Hs, as induction does not see them as inductive hypotheses.
Ltac glu_univ_elem_induction H :=
  let IHn := fresh "IH" H in
  let HH := fresh "Hglue" in
  rename H into HH;
  glu_univ_elem_induction_core HH ltac:(idtac; let n := fresh IHn in intro n).

As induction 1 using glu_univ_elem_ind.
Ltac glu_univ_elem_induction1 :=
  intros until 1;
  match goal with
  | H : glu_univ_elem _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      glu_univ_elem_induction_core H ltac:(idtac; let n := fresh "IH" in intro n)
  end.

Glued Declarations

The judgments of a declaration's typing, read in the gluing model, as valid_ind_decl reads them in the PER model. nparams_prefix D k is the context of the first k non-uniform parameters, nonrec_args_prefix gs k that of the first k non-recursive arguments of a constructor.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

The judgments of a record's declaration, glued: what the rule of the type former premises, read in the gluing model.
Record glu_record_decl (R : record_decl) : Prop := mk_glu_record_decl
  {
The parameters are a context glued with its types
    glued_params : glu_rel_ctx_types (record_params R)
    
The sort is a universe, small at a level glued at its instances
  ; glued_sort : (exists i : nat, record_sort R = Typeω@i) \/
      (exists L (n : nat), record_sort R = Type⟨L⟩ /\ glu_rel_exp_under_sub (record_params R) L (Level@n))
    
Each field is glued at its instances at the sort of its kind next to the record's sort, over the fields before it
  ; glued_fields : forall k f T, List.nth_error (record_fields R) k = Some (f, T) ->
      glu_rel_exp_under_sub (record_fctx R k ++ record_params R) T
        (abs_kind_sort (record_field_kind R k) (record_sort R)[wk_shiftn k]ʷ) }.

The views of a group with its members as variables (grp_selfs_ctx), as views_self_valid reads them in the PER model: each view's instance is IsS there, read at the group's own path, and is glued there. Once the group is filed, a glued grp_sb sends the instances to the group's uniform parameters (filed_view_is_glu).
Record glu_views_self (D : ind_decl) (IsS : nat -> list exp) : Prop := mk_glu_views_self
  {
Each view's uniform arguments are its IsS instance with the members sent to the group's own type formers (grp_sb)
    glu_views_self_link : forall mp, ind_mpath D 0 = Some mp ->
      forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
        Is = List.map (fun I => I[grp_sb mp D]) (IsS k)
    
Each instance argument is glued at the container's uniform telescope at its instances over the members as variables
  ; glu_views_self_is : forall k Mk qc k' Is vm Dq j I T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
      ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq -> List.nth_error (IsS k) j = Some I ->
      List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams Dq) Id (IsS k)) j = Some T ->
      glu_rel_exp_under_sub (grp_selfs_ctx D) I T
    
Each record view's instance is its IsS instance with the members sent to the group's own type formers
  ; glu_views_self_record_link : forall mp, ind_mpath D 0 = Some mp ->
      forall k Mk qr Is fl, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
        Is = List.map (fun I => I[grp_sb mp D]) (IsS k)
    
Each record view's instance argument is glued at the record's parameters at its instances over the members as variables
  ; glu_views_self_record_instances : forall k Mk qr Is fl R j I T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      record_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qr = Some R -> List.nth_error (IsS k) j = Some I ->
      List.nth_error (tele_insts (record_params R) Id (IsS k)) j = Some T ->
      glu_rel_exp_under_sub (grp_selfs_ctx D) I T
    
Each record view's record is glued: the local counterpart of completeness' valid_group_records
  ; glu_views_self_records : forall k Mk qr Is fl R, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      record_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qr = Some R -> glu_record_decl R }.

A group glued: the judgments of its typing, read in the gluing model (see the section header).
Record glu_ind_decl (D : ind_decl) : Prop := mk_glu_ind_decl
{
Each member's parameters are a context glued with its types
  glu_ind_decl_params : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> glu_rel_ctx_types (im_params D Mk)
The sort's level is a level glued at its instances over the uniform parameters
; glu_ind_decl_lvl : exists n, glu_rel_exp_under_sub (ind_uparams D) (ind_sort_lvl (ind_sort D)) (Level@n)
And over each member's parameters
; glu_ind_decl_lvlP : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
    exists n, glu_rel_exp_under_sub (im_params D Mk) (ind_sort_lvl (ind_sort D))[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ (Level@n)
Each non-uniform parameter is a type of the sort glued at its instances, over those before it
; glu_ind_decl_nparams : forall k Mk j κ A, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) j = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub (nparams_prefix Mk j ++ ind_uparams D) A (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn j]ʷ
Each non-recursive argument is a type of the sort of its kind next to the group's sort glued at its instances, over the non-recursive arguments before it
; glu_ind_decl_arg : forall k Mk c gs j r A, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
    List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gs) j = Some A -> List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec_kinds gs) j = Some r ->
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub (nonrec_args_prefix gs j ++ im_params D Mk) A (abs_kind_sort r (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (j + im_nn Mk)]ʷ)
Each parameter of a recursive argument's shape is glued at its instances at its member's telescope
; glu_ind_decl_rec_field : forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Mj m P T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
    gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
    List.nth_error (ptyp_ps t) m = Some P ->
    List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj)
                      (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (ptyp_depth t + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + im_nn Mk))) (ptyp_ps t)) m
      = Some T ->
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub (ptyp_tele t ++ nonrec_args_prefix gs (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ++ im_params D Mk) P T
The domains of a recursive argument's shape, each over those before it, are types of the sort glued at their instances.
; glu_ind_decl_dom : forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 j B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
    gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> List.nth_error (ptyp_doms t) j = Some B ->
    glu_rel_exp_under_sub (doms_ctx (List.firstn j (ptyp_doms t)) ++ nonrec_args_prefix gs (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ++ im_params D Mk)
      B (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (j + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + im_nn Mk)]ʷ
The contexts of a shape's domains are glued with their types
; glu_ind_decl_dctx : forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 j, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
    gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> j <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
    glu_rel_ctx_types (doms_ctx (List.firstn j (ptyp_doms t)) ++ nonrec_args_prefix gs (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ++ im_params D Mk)
The uniform arguments of a view's container, each at the instance of the container's telescope, over the group's members as variables.
; glu_ind_decl_view_self : exists IsS, glu_views_self D IsS
}.

End Fixed_GCtx.

Sound Embeddings

A definition stored over the telescope T, of the type A and the body oM closed over it, glued over T: the type A0 it closes, at the sort of the kind r at the level i, and the body M0 it closes, if any, at A0.
Record glu_def_over_tele (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (r : abs_kind) (A : typ) (oM : option exp) (A0 : typ) (i : nat) : Prop :=
  mk_glu_def_over_tele
  {
The type is A0 closed over T
    glu_def_over_tele_type_eq : A = ctx_pi_at r T A0
    
A0 is glued over T at the sort of the kind
  ; glu_def_over_tele_type : @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) T A0 (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i)
    
The body, if any, is a body M0 closed over T, glued over T at A0
  ; glu_def_over_tele_body : forall M, oM = Some M -> exists M0, M = ctx_fn T M0 /\ @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) T M0 A0 }.

Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 embeds soundly into Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2: it grows into it, its declarations glue there, and so does a member of one of its stored bodies that is an axiom or an abstract definition, at its stored type.
Record glu_gctx_embedding (Θ1 : gdeps) (Ξ1 : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) : Prop :=
  {
It grows into the target
    glu_gctx_embedding_embedding : gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2
    
Each of its groups is glued at the target
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_ind_field : forall p D, ind_lookup Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some D -> @glu_ind_decl (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) D
    
Each of its records is glued at the target
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_record_field : forall p R, record_lookup Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some R -> @glu_record_decl (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) R
    
The type of a group member's type former, abstracted over the outer part of its parameters, is glued over the inner part
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_ind_former_type : forall p D k Mk Δ1 Δ2, ind_lookup Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      im_params D Mk = Δ1 ++ Δ2 -> exists i : nat, @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Δ2 (ctx_pi Δ1 (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ) (Typeω@i)
    
So is a record type former's
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_record_former_type : forall p R Δ1 Δ2, record_lookup Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some R ->
      record_params R = Δ1 ++ Δ2 -> exists i : nat, @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Δ2 (ctx_pi Δ1 (record_sort R)) (Typeω@i)
    
An axiom or an abstract definition of a stored body glues at its stored type
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_glob : forall p T Φ x Φ0 b pv r A oM Γ,
      loc Θ1 Ξ1 p T Φ ->
      gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some (gm_ext Φ0 x (ge_def b pv r A oM)) ->
      (if b then oM else None) = None ->
      @glu_rel_ctx (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ ->
      @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) A
    
The body of a definition of a stored body glues at its stored type, in the empty context: the value a member with a δ-reduct is read off (eval_sel_global)
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_body : forall p T Φ x Φ0 E A M,
      loc Θ1 Ξ1 p T Φ ->
      gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some (gm_ext Φ0 x E) ->
      entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
      @glu_rel_exp (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) ⋅ M A
    
A definition of a stored body glued over the body's telescope (glu_def_over_tele): the closed fields above are it closed over the telescope
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_def_tele : forall p T Φ x Φ0 b pv r A oM,
      loc Θ1 Ξ1 p T Φ -> gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some (gm_ext Φ0 x (ge_def b pv r A oM)) ->
      exists A0 (i : nat), glu_def_over_tele Θ2 Ξ2 T r A oM A0 i
    
So is the term part of a definition with a module part of a stored body, as a definition with a body
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_def_mod_tele : forall p T Φ x Φ0 pv A M U,
      loc Θ1 Ξ1 p T Φ -> gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some (gm_ext Φ0 x (ge_def_mod pv A M U)) ->
      exists A0 (i : nat), glu_def_over_tele Θ2 Ξ2 T ak_relevant A (Some M) A0 i
    
An alias module stored at a path of the source is a deep unit over no context at the target: its parameters, its target and the target's parts are glued at the instances (glu_unit_deep). So its literal, the closure a global alias submodule is selected as (eval_selm_global_alias), is glued at the empty environment (glu_gctx_embedding_alias_modexp)
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_alias_deep : forall p U,
      gc_module Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some (mr_alias U) -> @glu_unit_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) ⋅ U
    
The telescope of a module stored at a path of the source is a context glued with its types at the target: the types of the parameters a global module value lacks
  ; glu_gctx_embedding_tele : forall p T Φ,
      gc_loc Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some (T, Φ) -> @glu_rel_ctx_types (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) T
  }.

The Gluing Judgments

A gluing judgment is stated at a global context Θ ⍮ Ξ and holds at every global context Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 that Θ ⍮ Ξ embeds into soundly (glu_gctx_embedding), as the gluing relation read there. The model is unary, so there are three judgments: a context glues, a term glues at its type, and a universe is one. Of the other judgments (equality, subtyping, extensions, units and module expressions), soundness states that their context glues.
A universe at one target, as its two cases: large, or small at a level that glues at every instance.
Record glu_is_univ_at (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (U : typ) : Prop := mk_glu_is_univ_at
  {
The context glues with its variables' types
    glu_is_univ_at_ctx : @glu_rel_ctx_types (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ
    
A large universe, or a small one at a level glued at its instances
  ; glu_is_univ_at_univ : (exists i : nat, U = Typeω@i) \/
               (exists L (n : nat), U = Type⟨L⟩ /\ @glu_rel_exp_under_sub (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ L (Level@n))
    
The context's module parts are deep
  ; glu_is_univ_at_ctx_deep : @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ }.

Arguments glu_is_univ_at_ctx {Θ2 Ξ2 Γ U}.
Arguments glu_is_univ_at_univ {Θ2 Ξ2 Γ U}.
Arguments glu_is_univ_at_ctx_deep {Θ2 Ξ2 Γ U}.

A unit at one target: glued at the instances, deep, its context's module parts deep.
Record glu_unit_at_target (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (U : gunit) : Prop := mk_glu_unit_at_target
  {
The unit is glued at the instances
    glu_unit_at_target_inst : @glu_rel_unit_under_sub (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ U
    
It is deep
  ; glu_unit_at_target_deep : @glu_unit_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ U
    
The context's module parts are deep
  ; glu_unit_at_target_ctx_deep : @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ }.

A module expression at one target: glued at the instances, its parts deep, its context's module parts deep.
Record glu_modexp_at_target (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (H : modexp) : Prop := mk_glu_modexp_at_target
  {
It is glued at the instances
    glu_modexp_at_target_inst : @glu_rel_modexp_under_sub (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ H
    
Its literals and application arguments are deep
  ; glu_modexp_at_target_parts : @glu_modexp_parts_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ H
    
The context's module parts are deep
  ; glu_modexp_at_target_ctx_deep : @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ }.

A context glues with its variables' types, its module parts deep, at every sound embedding.
Definition glu_ctx Θ Ξ Γ : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> @glu_rel_ctx_types (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ /\ @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ.

A term glues at each of its instances, its context's module parts deep, at every sound embedding.
Definition glu_exp Θ Ξ Γ A M : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> @glu_rel_exp_under_sub (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ M A /\ @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ.

Definition glu_is_univ Θ Ξ Γ U : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> glu_is_univ_at Θ2 Ξ2 Γ U.

A unit glues at each of its instances and deeply, its context's module parts deep, at every sound embedding.
Definition glu_unit Θ Ξ Γ U : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> glu_unit_at_target Θ2 Ξ2 Γ U.

A module expression glues at each of its instances, its parts deep, its context's module parts deep, at every sound embedding.
Definition glu_modexp Θ Ξ Γ H : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> glu_modexp_at_target Θ2 Ξ2 Γ H.

An extension glues at each instance of its context, the extended context's module parts deep, at every sound embedding.
Definition glu_ext Θ Ξ Γ Ψ : Prop :=
  forall Θ2 Ξ2, glu_gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> @glu_rel_ext_under_sub (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) Γ Ψ /\ @glu_ctx_deep (gc_mk Θ2 Ξ2) (Ψ ++ Γ)%list.

A unit equation glues: its context glues with its variables' types, and each of its units glues at the instances of the context. It has no notation: Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ᵘ U ≈ U' would extend the notation Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ᵘ U of glu_unit past its end, which the parser does not accept beside it.
Record glu_unit_eq (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (U U' : gunit) : Prop := mk_glu_unit_eq
  {
The context glues
    glu_unit_eq_ctx : glu_ctx Θ Ξ Γ
    
The left unit glues at the instances
  ; glu_unit_eq_left : glu_unit Θ Ξ Γ U
    
The right unit glues at the instances
  ; glu_unit_eq_right : glu_unit Θ Ξ Γ U' }.

Notation "⊩ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ" := (glu_ctx Θ Ξ Γ)
  (at level 70, Θ at next level, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69) : type_scope.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ M : A" := (glu_exp Θ Ξ Γ A M)
  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69, M at level 69, A at level 69) : type_scope.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ᵤ U" := (glu_is_univ Θ Ξ Γ U)
  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69, U at level 69) : type_scope.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ᵘ U" := (glu_unit Θ Ξ Γ U)
  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69, U at level 69) : type_scope.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊩ˣ Ψ" := (glu_ext Θ Ξ Γ Ψ)
  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69, Ψ at level 69) : type_scope.
